notes: The supplied text (catalog pages 76-77) is the Mendocino College local General Education pattern for associate degrees. It is not the section for the CSU GE Breadth Certificate of Achievement. No requirements, total units, outcomes or careers for that certificate are printed here, so no blocks are recorded. The certificate's own catalog page should be checked.

The PDF extraction scrambles the multi-column layout. The course lists run under the wrong area headings: Area 2 and Area 3 headings are followed by science courses, and some lines are fragments such as 'Contemporary (3 units)', 'Resuscitation (3 units)' and 'Majors (5 units)'. Even if this local GE pattern were the intended source, area membership could not be read reliably.
The closed list uses codes ART 209 and HST 208, while the catalog prints ARTH 209 and HIST 208. Possible code changes should be verified.
The text has typographic splits such as 'IT A 200', 'ST AT C1000' and 'CHM250' as printed.
